default_in_repayment.text:
On the basis of examination of records and according to the information and explanation given to us:
(a) The Company has not defaulted in repayment of loans or other borrowings or in the payment of interest thereon to any lender.
(b) As disclosed in note no. 56(viii) of the Standalone Financial Statements, the Company is not declared wilful defaulter by any bank or financial institution or other lender.
(c) On an examination of records of the Company, we report that the term loans were applied for the purpose for which the loans were obtained.
(d) We report that the Company has not utilised funds raised on short-term basis for long-term purposes.
(e) The Company has not taken any funds from any entity or person on account of or to meet the obligations of its subsidiaries, associates or joint ventures.
(f) The Company has not raised loans during the year on the pledge of securities held in its subsidiaries, joint ventures or associate companies.

fraud.text:
(a) There are no instances of fraud by the Company or on the Company noticed or reported during the year except an instance of fraud of approx. Rs. 8.14 crores by an employee by misuse of his authority.
(b) No report under sub-section (12) of section 143 of the Companies Act has been filed by the auditors in Form ADT-4 as prescribed under rule 13 of Companies (Audit and Auditors) Rules, 2014 with the Central Government, during the year and up to the date of this report.
(c) As represented to us by the management, there are no whistle blower complaints received by the Company during the year.

call_points.text: Conductor EBITDA per MT reached ₹48,241, significantly above the medium-term baseline.
Oil division volumes fell 20% YoY to 1,28,590 KL due to lower demand.
US revenue in Q2 FY27 declined 29.7% YoY and is flat sequentially.
H1FY27 operating cash flow was negative ₹863 Cr due to inventory build-up.
Medium to long-term Conductor EBITDA margin guided at ₹35,000–₹36,000 per MT plus tailwinds.
Targeting 10% YoY volume growth in Conductors and 25% YoY growth in Cables.
Supplied $15 million worth of cables across 3 major data center projects in the US.
Middle East war disrupted Oil exports in March and April due to freight spikes and supply chain halts.
Q4 PAT included ₹31 Cr non-operating items; excluding them, operating PAT grew 14% YoY to ₹285 Cr.
High metal prices will increase interest costs as working capital funding requirements rise.
Short-term demand slowdown expected due to higher metal prices, elevated freights, and war premiums.
Conductor Division 12M FY26 new order inflow reached ₹11,450 Cr, up 24.2% YoY.
Conductor Division pending order book stands at ₹7,671 Cr with 38.9% export mix.
Cable Division pending order book reached ₹1,800 Cr.
Q4 PAT had one-off impacts; excluding them, PAT would have grown 14% YoY in Q4.
Conductor EBITDA per MT increased to ₹44,919 in Q4 FY26 from ₹41,430 in Q4 FY25.
12M FY26 consolidated revenue rose 23.3% YoY to ₹22,902 Cr, hitting an all-time high.
Conductor pending order book stood at ₹7,671 crore with an export mix of 38.9%.
New order inflow for conductors in 12M FY26 reached ₹11,450 crore, up 24.2% YoY.

Cable Division pending order book stands at ₹1,800 Cr.
FY26 conductor segment revenue reached ₹12,712 Cr and cable segment revenue reached ₹6,220 Cr.

FY27 capex allocated as ₹850 Cr for Cables, ₹400 Cr for Conductors, and ₹200 Cr for Oil.
Oil division made ₹94 Cr provision for inventory valuation as per accounting standards
Conductor division achieved all-time highest reconducting installations in the quarter
Cable division approved for data center cables in U.S. for Meta, Microsoft and Google
Q2FY27 results include US tariff refunds of ₹42.75 Cr net of customer repayments.
Company infused ₹5.76 Cr into its wholly owned subsidiary APAR Brazil Ltda during the quarter.
Petroleum Specialties Pte Ltd (Singapore) reported zero turnover for the last three financial years (FY24-FY26).
Conductor division pending order book stands at ₹12,025 Cr.
Cable division pending order book stands at ₹3,012 Cr.
Conductor capacity reached 2,77,327 MT in FY26.
Cable capacity expanded to 9,50,656 KM in FY26.
Company has supplied $15 million in cables for US data centre projects.
Hebei Jinghuan Cable Co. Ltd will operate as a 100% export-focused enterprise for aluminium overhead conductors.

timeline.summary: Kushal N. Desai (Promoter-Chairman, MD & CEO) and Chaitanya N. Desai (Promoter-MD) declared no encumbrance on APAR Industries shares for FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Reg. 31(4).
Board of Directors recommended final dividend of ₹60 per equity share (₹241.01 crore total) on May 28, 2026, pending AGM approval.
Apar Industries reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹6,603 Cr (+26.7% YoY) and 12M FY26 revenue of ₹22,902 Cr (+23.3% YoY).
Apar Industries released its corporate presentation for May 2026, highlighting FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹22,902 Cr.
Apar Industries Limited shared the audio recording of its Q4FY26 earnings conference call held on May 28, 2026, via its website.
Apar Industries hosted its Q4FY26 concall detailing a ₹1,500 Cr FY27 capex plan and US data center expansion.
Apar Industries corrected the distinctive number range for equity shares allotted under its ESAR Plan 2024.
Apar Industries reported Q1FY27 results with record revenue of ₹6,591 Cr, up 29.1% YoY, and PAT of ₹467 Cr, up 77.7% YoY.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹6,931.19 Cr (+21.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹447.32 Cr (+77.7% YoY).
Apar Industries reported Q2FY27 PAT growth and approved an additional investment of up to USD 100 million in its Singapore subsidiary.
Apar Industries reported Q2FY27 PAT growth of 77.8% YoY and a record Conductor order book of ₹12,025 Cr.
Apar Industries announced a front-loaded FY27 capex plan of ₹1,500 Cr to target grid modernization and AI data centre growth.
Apar Industries reported utilization of ₹1,939.86 Cr out of its ₹2,500 Cr QIP proceeds as of September 30, 2026.
Apar Industries Limited submitted the audio recording of its post‑conference call on Un‑audited Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) for Q2FY27, effective October 29, 2026.
Apar Industries' Singapore subsidiary signed an agreement to acquire a 70% stake in China-based Hebei Jinghuan Cable Co. Ltd for RMB 24.85 million.
